title: The Journeyman Hammer
description: Torven's journeyman hammer — fifteen years of work in the grip — was stolen by a Goblin Looter patrol. He tracked them to the dungeon entrance but couldn't go further. He asked you to retrieve it.

stages.description: Locate the hammer in the goblin territory on Dungeon Floor 1.
stages.objective_text: Find Torven's journeyman hammer in the goblin territory (Dungeon Floor 1).
Return the hammer to Torven at his forge.

title: Dungeon Survey — Floor 1
description: The Adventurers' Guild needs a survey of the dungeon's first floor: creature types, patrol patterns, resource nodes. Standard first-contract work.

stages.objective_text: Engage or observe the goblin patrol (Floor 1, west corridor).

stages.description: Locate and document the crystal chamber.
stages.objective_text: Find and document the crystal chamber resource node.
Report survey results to Sylara at the Adventurers' Guild.

title: The Quiet Thief
description: Mira at the Iron Compass Inn has had small valuables stolen from guests — a coin purse, a ring, a carved bone token. She can't go to the Guard. She needs someone who notices things to find out who it is.

stages.description: Interview guests or observe the inn to gather clues.
stages.objective_text: Find clues about the thief at the Iron Compass Inn.

stages.description: Identify the thief and confront or expose them.
stages.objective_text: Identify who is stealing from short-term guests at the inn.
Report your findings to Mira at the Iron Compass.
